invariants.statement: GCC diagnoses conflicting hard-register bindings between inline-assembly output operands, matching input operands, and early-clobber outputs.
GCC dead-store elimination preserves tail bytes when trimming them could defeat proper out-of-bounds warnings.
GCC AArch64 defines a stack-protector guard mode that uses a per-thread canary stored in a special system register.
GCC emits a stack-protection epilogue check for functions configured with a stack-protect guard and a runtime-enabled stack-protection target.
When hardware-assisted stack sanitization is active, stack-variable allocation records tag coverage for each allocated object and advances the frame tag after allocation units.
GCC preserves distinct hard-register requirements for repeated pseudo-register inputs in inline assembly by introducing a copy for each subsequent constrained use.
GCC records the AArch64 GCS security feature in GNU ELF property metadata when GCS is enabled before metadata emission.
Address Sanitizer stack layout keeps differently sized supported-alignment partition representatives separate so shorter variables receive adequate protection.

At the frame-pointer epilogue path, when `aarch64_add_offset` emits a stack-pointer restoration whose callee-save restoration uses writeback, the CFA/unwind state must be restored on that same writeback instruction, so unwind metadata remains synchronized with the resulting stack-relative frame position. This is the intended guarantee stated by the adjacent `aarch64_expand_epilogue` comment, not independently demonstrated behavior.
GCC assigns at least one byte to each zero-sized stack variable so that simultaneously live stack variables retain distinct addresses.
GCC dead-store elimination preserves the object-size argument of four-argument checked memory calls when head-trimming a memcpy, memmove, or memset operation.
GCC emits a stack-protector epilogue check before a sibling call, or before a non-returning call that can throw, when stack protection is active at runtime.
GCC records the AArch64 BTI security feature in GNU ELF property metadata when BTI is enabled before metadata emission.
GCC rejects debug-expression subregister expansion when the bit position is at or beyond the operand mode width, preventing the subregister generator from being invoked with a non-existent address.
GCC runs its early sprintf format-checking warning pass only when optimization is disabled and either format-overflow or format-truncation warnings are enabled.

The AArch64 SIMD lane-check builtin is folded to a void result only when its total size, element size, and lane arguments are integer constants, both sizes are nonzero, and the unsigned lane value is less than total-size divided by element-size.
GCC warns when a bounded string-copy call is determined to truncate output before a terminating NUL character or may do so.
GCC passes memtag-stack linker options when memtag-stack sanitization is requested, selecting synchronous mode unless an explicit memtag mode is supplied.

At `gsi_insert_finally_seq_after_call`'s newly created EH-cleanup block, the landing-pad label and call-to-landing-pad association (`lp->post_landing_pad`, `EH_LANDING_PAD_NR (label)`, and `add_stmt_to_eh_lp (stmt, lp->index)`) must designate a block that, before its EH edge is usable, contains the non-empty requested cleanup sequence followed by the generated `resx`; metadata must not remain bound to an empty or cleanup-less block. Source evidence: `create_empty_bb (bb)` precedes those metadata assignments, while `gsi_insert_seq_before (&gsi, seq, GSI_SAME_STMT)` and insertion of `gimple_build_resx (new_r->index)` populate the block before `make_eh_edge (stmt)` wires it into the CFG.
GCC exempts an indirect call from control-flow verification when the call has the nocf_check attribute.
GCC requires -fasan-shadow-offset to be used with -fsanitize=kernel-address.
GCC prevents sibling-call optimization of __sanitizer_cov_trace_pc calls so the hook can inspect its return address to identify its caller.
GCC rejects AArch64 Memory Tagging builtin calls when the function lacks the required ISA extension.
GCC's analyzer models a successful moving realloc as invalidating pointers to the old heap buffer.
GCC rejects by-value arguments that would require an excessively large stack argument area, preventing later argument-size arithmetic overflow.
GCC prevents live-patching modes from being used with selected interprocedural and whole-program optimizations that can change program structure relevant to patching.
GCC emits a stack-protector guard comparison that transfers control to the stack-protector failure handler when the guard values differ.
GCC initializes the stack-protection guard through the stack-protection prologue only when a guard is configured and the target runtime reports stack protection as enabled.
GCC selects strong stack protection by default under -fhardened when the stack-protector option was not explicitly set.
On Android, SIGSEGV handling is configured to execute on a dedicated alternate signal stack so a stack-overflow signal handler can run without consuming the faulting stack.

At this confluence site, combining ACTIVE_LIVE with ACTIVE_DEAD must yield ACTIVE_LIVE in either operand order: ACTIVE_DEAD denotes conditionally initialized ZA state that must be accepted as compatible with fully initialized, live ZA state rather than being treated as an unknown or incompatible state.
Aggregate copy propagation must not replace a temporary-mediated memory copy with a direct memory-to-memory store when the source and destination may overlap at different locations.
The final forward-propagation pass must not rewrite predecessor conditional branches to bypass a block beginning with __builtin_unreachable when unreachable sanitization is enabled.
GCC preserves -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE and -U_FORTIFY_SOURCE options in its generated producer command-line string, while excluding other macro-definition options.
GCC rejects sibling-call expansion when an argument value may overlap an already clobbered outgoing argument area.
GCC prevents an eligible tail call from bypassing a pending AddressSanitizer epilogue sequence.
GCC sibling-call handling is intended to avoid overwriting incoming function arguments before their reads are complete.
GCC enables zero initialization of trivial automatic variables under -fhardened unless the user explicitly set a different auto-variable-initialization mode.
GCC's strlen pass performs bounds-or-overlap analysis for strcpy-like calls when source string information is available.
GCC defaults to PIE and PIC under -fhardened when neither PIE nor PIC was explicitly selected.
GCC records the AArch64 PAC security feature in GNU ELF property metadata when PAC is enabled before metadata emission.
GCC diagnoses a string copy that omits the terminating NUL when the copy bound is the source string length.
GCC marks sibling-call expansion as failed when an argument setup sequence dereferences an argument slot already clobbered by tail-call argument setup.
